Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Punchline: MIDI Editor, Bard Workbench, native ensembles, and concert capture.
Description: Windbound Bard MIDI suite with a piano roll, MIDI Workbench, native ensembles and MP4 concert capture. Concert Director adds same-PC next-bar rejoin, whole-set preflight, timing reports, assigned-part rehearsal and portable concert packs. Includes customizable shortcut bars and same-PC song sharing.
